QuestInfo.name: [Black Wings] Warriors Get Hungry Too
QuestInfo.0: Black Wing management #b#p2154000##k at the #b#m310050100##k in the Mine appears to be extremely hungry.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2154000# and #p2154001# only seem to do as much work as a single person, combined. They don't go on nearly as many business trips, because they prefer training. They're unlike any others in management. Find food for #p2154000#, who's famished from heavy training.  #r#o7150002##k seems to want meat.

#i4032770# #t4032770# #b#c4032770# / 30#k

0.0: #p2154001# and I don't enjoy being outside for very long like the other bosses do. We enjoy training on our own more. That is why we have taken on the responsibilities of guarding the Power Plant. It's a perfect situation where we get to train while doing our job.
0.1: I'm getting hungry from training so much... Newbie-Dewbie, help #p2154001# and me out, okay? It's very difficult to train when we are hungry.

yes.0: Ah, thank you kindly. Please hunt #r#o7150002#s#k and bring us some #b#t4032770#s#k. About #b30#k of them should be enough to make #p2154001# and me feel full.

no.0: Hmm, we will only be able to fully exert our force when we train together.

1.0: You brought the #t4032770#s? Thank you. Now we can focus on our training. Though #p2154001# may be quiet, I am sure he is quite thankful as well.

yes.0: It's a good thing that Baroq's room is next to ours. The marble walls are perfect for conducting target tests.

item.0: Have you not been able to obtain the #b#t4032770#s#k yet? There is only #rone type of bear around here#k. They shouldn't be too hard to find.
